ben: Quick async check — QTR OKR milestone status please. Drop one-line entries (area | owner | status | blocker | next step) by EOD Thu. I'll collate. Example format:
```
serving-runtime | tom | shipped | n/a | follow-up: EU rollout
```
ben: Please only 1-2 lines per item, ping if you need more time. :pray:
mina: Product OKR lines coming. I'll add product-facing telemetry shipped; ownership = mina; status = shipped; blocker = none; next = docs + marketing sync.
tom: serving-runtime | tom | shipped | small perf regression in long-tail sequences uncovered in canary | next: hotfix rolling, will ping @ava if infra needed. PR: #4312
ava: infra-autoscale | ava | slipped -> at-risk | staging autoscaler flaps, caused failed smoke runs | next: rolling back autoscale change, creating postmortem ticket infra-786. ETA EOD Fri.
rachel: quant-recs | rachel | at-risk | missing evaluation set for edge prompts | next: need review on eval harness PR (#4567) from @chris and @tom, can help set up dataset.
chris: dedicated-capacity | chris | shipped in NA | EU rollout partially blocked by subnet limits | next: infra req #789 opened, need approvals from networking owners.
zach: ux-messaging | zach | shipped | docs still outdated | next: will open docs PR, can someone on product review text? docs PR: docs#123
deploy-bot: Canary deploy for runtime-v2 passed in NA region. Note: EU canary pending due to infra quota.
ben: Thanks all — two asks: 1) owners update the single-line status in this thread (easy to collate). 2) If you're listed as blocked, add the ticket link inline. I'll produce a single-sheet summary for execs. :memo:
mina: I'll stitch and circulate the summary by Mon AM. If anything changes before then, append here and I'll pick it up.
tom: noted — I'll post the EU rollout checklist after the hotfix lands.
rachel: pinging @chris for eval infra time, @mina FYI.
ava: tagging networking on infra-786, will update when rollback completes.
ben: perfect — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
